sfc_structure.component: root — the SFC file; emits a Class symbol (isVueComponent/isSfc)
sfc_structure.template_element: template block — component usages -> instantiates; v-if/v-for/v-show -> template decision points
sfc_structure.script_element: script block — delegated to the JS/TS sub-analyzer, THREE-WAY by lang (M60/#903: ts / tsx / js), via the engine-provided sfcScriptTrees
sfc_structure.style_element: style block — skipped; CSS belongs to the dedicated css analyzer (D1, RULED)

template.element: instantiates (non-builtin tag, isComponentUsage) — leaf tag name as written
template.directive_attribute: v-if/v-else-if/v-for/v-show are template decision points (complexity); the binding VALUE is tokenized by a stack machine: chain roots only, string contents skipped, v-for/slot bindings shadow members (V4), object-literal keys are not reads (F10)
template.interpolation: {{ expr }} — template expression: a chain-ROOT member read, or a contract/use edge to a member (V2 CLOSED; F10: an object-literal KEY is not a read)

script.defineProps: Property symbols from the object/array (inline) forms and from a same-file binding; a NAMED or IMPORTED type or binding emits a `references` edge to the declaring name with metadata.isPropContract (F12) — the shape a real component library writes, and the one the original V1 gap did not cover
script.defineEmits: Event symbols from the array/object (inline) forms; a NAMED type or a binding emits a `references` edge with metadata.isEmitContract (F12)
script.vue_options_component: options-object component symbol (name: option) + props/emits/data/methods via extractOptionsApi

expressions_requiring_uses_or_calls: interpolation {{ count }} — chain-root member read; a ternary VALUE survives the key-position rule and a computed key's CONTENT is a real read (F10, pinned both ways)
directive value expressions :label=@event=v-model — same tokenizer, same rules
script expressions — delegated to the JS/TS analyzer (calls/uses/references). The `references` half of that delegation is NOT in the differential's audited set — declared debt, not a claim
statements_affecting_complexity: template directives: v-if / v-else-if / v-for / v-show
NOT counted: v-else, v-bind, v-on, v-model, v-text, v-html, v-pre, v-once, v-cloak, v-memo — measured, fixture-pinned
_notes: Vue SFC = template + script + style; the script is parsed by the JS/TS sub-analyzer, so script-side edges follow those analyzers. The dispatch is THREE-WAY by lang since M60/#903 — an earlier 'always JS' claim in the docs was false from that commit onward.
Component usages in template are instantiates (usage_contextual); builtin HTML + Vue tags filtered. A NAMESPACED builtin (`<svg:circle />`) is a known false positive (F9).
The component is ONE Class symbol named by the declared `name:` option (F8). Every component-owned edge sources that one name.

100% differential coverage is a claim about the AUDITED LABELS only: calls, extends, instantiates, overrides, and the contract-marked `references` rows. `contains`, `uses` and the other ~2,750 `references` rows are unaudited and the rel-type-coverage gate reports them.

declarations.component: ONE Class symbol per SFC, named by the DECLARED `name:` option and falling back to the file stem; the stem is kept in metadata.moduleName (F8 — the previous shape published two Class symbols with disjoint edge sets, neither reachable as a target)
declarations.props: Property, ownerName = the component. Sources: Options `props:` inline object/array, `defineProps` inline forms, a same-file binding, and an `extends`/`mixins` inline object (F1). The Options hoist to a NAMED declaration is an edge, not symbols (F12)
declarations.emits: Event, ownerName = the component. Same sources as props
declarations.data keys: Property with metadata.isDataKey, one per key, last-wins on a duplicate (#745). A BRACKET-LED computed key is skipped (F6)
declarations.methods / computed / watchers: Method / Property / Method, ownerName = the component, with the delegate's parameters, returnType, complexity and qualified_calls copied (VSD18)
declarations.lifecycle hooks: Method, ownerName = the component; `setup()` is NOT in the set (F5, open)
declarations.heritage: extends/mixins -> `extends` edges with metadata.isMixin distinguishing class inheritance from an options merge (F1)
declarations.provide / inject: `references` to the key with metadata.isProvideContract / isInjectContract; a provided inline object's keys are the component's own members, ANNOTATED onto the delegate's symbols rather than re-pushed, because the store's symbol key excludes owner (F2, VSD25)
